synth.shared_helper_design:
SHARED HELPER (PP-3 EDIT A) — VERIFIED AUTHORABLE AS WRITTEN IN THE DESIGN. Place it in /workspace/SuperGrok1.5/csrc/fused/sm_90/fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh, inserted between the close of dec_tc_workspace_floats() (live line 655, `}`) and `#ifdef SG_DEC_PROFILE` (live line 657). VERIFIED: this sits inside `namespace sg { namespace fused { namespace sm90 {` (opened live :140, closed live :1573) — the same namespace the production kernel and all the sizers live in — so the helper reaches the dectc:: binders with the `dectc::` prefix exactly as the production carve does (dectc::dec_acts_bind :798, dectc::dec_wbf_bind :806, etc.), and reaches kDecTotalElems unqualified exactly as the production carve does (:732/:744; it is constexpr int64_t in decoder_layout.cuh, visible in scope). dec::kVocab/kLayers/kD stay dec::-qualified (consistent with the production carve). The dectc:: members it returns — DecActs/DecTileScratch/DecWBf, dec_acts_bind :419, dec_tile_scratch_bind :1338, dec_wbf_bind :506, dec_wbf_floats :503, kDecDwTransposeActive :1994, kLnVecElems :342 — all live in `namespace dectc` (opened model_stage :205, closed :2591) nested in sg::fused::sm90, so the prefixes resolve.

EXACT SIGNATURE:
  __device__ __forceinline__ DecTcWorkspace
  dec_tc_bind_workspace(float* ws, int T, int B, int nCTA, int cta);

RETURN STRUCT (DecTcWorkspace) — a trivially-copyable POD aggregate of pointers + POD binders (no ctors), so __forceinline at -O3 folds it to byte-identical PTX for <Opt,SingleGPU>:
  __nv_bfloat16* acts_base; float* scratch_base; int64_t scratch_per;
  float* lnvec_base; float* loss_part; float* loss_out; float* dw_part;
  float* opt_reduce; float* muon_base; float* sam_backup; float* sam_grad;
  float* sg2_ws_base; float* wbf_f; __nv_bfloat16* wbf_cache;
  int* embed_row_start; int* embed_perm; __nv_bfloat16* dwt_base;
  dectc::DecActs acts; dectc::DecTileScratch sc; dectc::DecWBf wb; float* my_lnvec;

POINTER CHAIN IT RETURNS (reproduces the live production carve, lines 705-806, VERBATIM in term order — VERIFIED line-by-line against the live tree):
  acts_base    = (bf16*)ws
  scratch_base = ws + dec_tc_acts_floats(T,B)
  scratch_per  = dectc::dec_tile_scratch_total_f32()
  lnvec_base   = scratch_base + nCTA*scratch_per
  loss_part    = lnvec_base   + nCTA*dectc::kLnVecElems
  loss_out     = loss_part    + nCTA
  dw_part      = loss_out     + 1
  opt_reduce   = dw_part      + dec_tc_dw_part_floats()
  muon_base    = opt_reduce   + dec_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)
  sam_backup   = muon_base    + dec_tc_muon_floats(nCTA)
  sam_grad     = sam_backup   + kDecTotalElems
  sg2_ws_base  = sam_grad     + kDecTotalElems; then 8B-align bump (if &0x7) +=1   [matches live :744-745]
  #if SG_DEC_BENCH_LAYOUT  : wbf_f = opt_reduce + dec_tc_staged_opt_floats(nCTA)   [matches live :760]
  #else (production)       : wbf_f = sg2_ws_base + dec_tc_sg2_floats(nCTA)         [matches live :772]
                             then 16B-align: while(&0xF) wbf_f+=1                  [matches live :765/:775]
                             embed_ws = wbf_f + dectc::dec_wbf_floats()            [matches live :766/:776]
  AFTER the #endif (BOTH branches): if(embed_ws &0x7) embed_ws+=1                  [matches live :778 — OUTSIDE the #if]
  embed_row_start = (int*)embed_ws                 [matches :779]
  embed_perm      = embed_row_start + (dec::kVocab+1)  [matches :780]
  #if SG_TUNED_DEC_DW_STAGE : dwt_f=(float*)(embed_perm+T); while(&0xF)dwt_f+=1;
                              dwt_base = kDecDwTransposeActive ? (bf16*)dwt_f : nullptr  [matches :792-795]
  #else                     : dwt_base = nullptr   [preserves the off-path nullptr exactly]
  wbf_cache = (bf16*)wbf_f
  acts      = dectc::dec_acts_bind(acts_base, T, B)
  sc        = dectc::dec_tile_scratch_bind(scratch_base + cta*scratch_per)
  wb        = dectc::dec_wbf_bind(wbf_cache)
  my_lnvec  = lnvec_base + cta*dectc::kLnVecElems

PRODUCTION REWIRE (PP-3 EDIT A.2): REPLACE live lines 704-806 (the `// Workspace partition.` block through `dectc::DecWBf wb = dectc::dec_wbf_bind(wbf_cache);`) with `DecTcWorkspace W = dec_tc_bind_workspace(tok.workspace, T, B, nCTA, cta);` + the re-bind of every name as a const (or non-const for w/wb/acts/sc/my_lnvec — these are mutated downstream: SAM re-converts wb, P0 zeros my_lnvec, acts/sc pass by value) local from W, with (void) on the conditionally-used ones (reproduces the live `(void)sg2_ws_base;` at :746). This leaves the ~770 lines below :806 UNCHANGED (every downstream name reference is preserved). NOTE one correction vs the design text: the design A.2 omits re-binding the dw split-K group `const int kDwG = dectc::kDecDwSplitK;` (live :716) which is NOT a member of W — the rewrite must KEEP that line as-is (it is local, not workspace-derived), and likewise the `DecWeights w = dec_bind(params);` (live :802) stays. Author A.2 to retain kDwG and w exactly; only the workspace-pointer names move into W.

WHY THIS IS THE DRIFT-KILLER: after EDIT A lands, the production kernel + both PP kernels (PP-3 EDIT B) derive every workspace offset from ONE expression, so the embed-vs-wbf aliasing class (the live PP bwd bug at :195-196 that omits dec_wbf_floats() and aliases embed_row_start over the bf16 cache) cannot recur.
